# Flourrish Asset Management: full reference

Flourrish Asset Management is a Chennai-based property management company for NRI and local property owners. Founded by Shakeel and Farrah, it looks after apartments, villas, independent houses, offices and vacant properties across OMR, ECR and South Chennai, for a fee of 12% of the annual rental value.

## Services
### Tenants & rent
Finding the right people and making sure rent arrives.
- Tenant sourcing: Marketing your property, handling enquiries and running viewings.
- Tenant verification: Background checks and police verification before anyone moves in.
- Rent agreements: Written agreements prepared and registered with legal support.
- Rent collection: Due dates tracked, reminders sent and late payments followed up.
- Move-in & move-out: Inventory photos, key handover, deposit and utility coordination.
### Property care
Keeping the property in good condition, and showing you proof.
- Property inspections: Regular visits with a documented condition report.
- Video walkthroughs: Room-by-room video so you can see the property yourself.
- Maintenance coordination: Vendor estimates, your approval, the repair and completion photos.
- Emergency response: Local response to leaks, faults and break-ins, with alerts to you.
- Vacant property care: Cleaning, leak and pest checks and security visits while it's empty.
### Owner support
The paperwork and payments that come with owning property.
- Property tax: Authorised payments made on time, receipts kept with your documents.
- Utility bills: Electricity, water and gas paid on authorisation and reported monthly.
- RWA & association liaison: Association dues, notices and meetings handled for you.
- Owner reports: A monthly report covering rent, tenant, condition and expenses.
- NRI support: TDS, FEMA, POA and repatriation coordinated with CA and legal partners.

## Pricing
Flourrish charges 12% of the property's annual rental value, paid by the owner. For a flat let at ₹30,000 a month, that is ₹43,200 a year before applicable taxes. It covers tenant coordination, rent collection, maintenance coordination, inspections, reporting and owner communication. Major repairs, renovation, government charges, CA and legal fees are extra.

## Areas
### OMR
Flourrish manages apartments and homes along OMR (Old Mahabalipuram Road, officially Rajiv Gandhi Salai), including Perungudi, Thoraipakkam and Sholinganallur. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle association dues and repairs with your approval, and send a monthly video report. The fee is 12% of the annual rent.
- Perungudi: Close to the northern end of OMR and the older IT parks. Mostly apartments, with steady demand from people working nearby.
- Thoraipakkam: Dense residential stretch between Perungudi and Sholinganallur, with a mix of apartment blocks and independent houses.
- Sholinganallur: The junction where OMR meets the link road to ECR. Large gated communities and a busy rental market.
- Further along OMR: Navalur, Siruseri, Kelambakkam and beyond. Message us with the address and we'll confirm whether we can cover it.
### ECR
Flourrish looks after villas, beach houses and independent homes on ECR (East Coast Road), Chennai. We manage tenants where the home is rented, and run regular care visits where it stands empty: cleaning, leak and damp checks, garden and security checks, and preparation before cyclone warnings. The fee for rented homes is 12% of the annual rent.
- The city end of ECR: Neighbourhoods such as Neelankarai and Injambakkam, where many homes are lived in all year and rented to families.
- Further down the coast: Quieter stretches with larger villas and beach houses, often used at weekends or kept empty.
- Towards Mahabalipuram: For homes further south, send us the location and we'll confirm whether we can cover it.
### South Chennai
Flourrish manages houses and apartments in Adyar, Besant Nagar and Velachery in South Chennai. Many are older or inherited family homes whose owners now live abroad or in another city. We find verified tenants, collect rent, keep older buildings in good repair with your approval and send a monthly report with photos and video.
- Adyar: Established residential area near the Adyar river and IIT Madras, with independent houses and apartments.
- Besant Nagar: Quiet residential streets near Elliot's Beach, popular with families.
- Velachery: A busy hub with shopping, rail links and strong rental demand. Low-lying pockets need checks after heavy rain.
### Tambaram and GST Road
Flourrish manages property in Tambaram, Pallavaram, Medavakkam and Chengalpattu, Chennai's southern suburbs along GST Road. We find the first tenant for new flats, look after vacant homes and plots with regular checks, collect rent and handle repairs with your approval. The fee for rented property is 12% of the annual rent.
- Tambaram: A major southern suburb with rail links and a wide mix of homes.
- Pallavaram: Close to Chennai airport, with steady rental demand.
- Medavakkam: A fast-growing residential suburb between Velachery and Tambaram.
- Chengalpattu: At the southern edge of the metro region, with new projects and plots.

## NRI owners by country
### USA & Canada
Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs living in the USA and Canada. We find and verify tenants, collect rent into your Indian account, handle repairs only with your approval and send a monthly video report. Updates arrive on WhatsApp while you sleep, and calls are arranged for your evening, which is Chennai's morning.
Rent from your Chennai property is generally taxable in India, and the tenant is generally required to deduct TDS. If you are a US tax resident, the US generally taxes worldwide income too, and the India–US tax treaty may help avoid being taxed twice. US reporting rules may also apply to your Indian bank accounts. Canada has a tax treaty with India as well. Your Indian CA and your US or Canadian tax adviser should confirm what applies to you.
### UAE & Gulf
Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle repairs with your approval and send monthly video reports. With a small time difference, we can talk the same day, and we can keep your home ready for trips back or an eventual return.
The UAE does not tax personal income, but rent from your Chennai property is still generally taxable in India, and the tenant is generally required to deduct TDS. Rules differ across the Gulf states, and India has tax treaties with several of them. Your Chartered Accountant should confirm what applies to you.
### UK & Europe
Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs in the UK, Ireland and Europe. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle repairs with your approval and send monthly video reports. Your morning overlaps with Chennai's afternoon, so calls are easy to arrange, and we keep clear yearly records for your accountant.
Rent from your Chennai property is generally taxable in India, and the tenant is generally required to deduct TDS. If you are UK resident, the UK generally taxes worldwide income too, and the India–UK tax treaty may give relief so you aren't taxed twice. Your Indian CA and UK accountant should confirm what applies to you.
### Singapore & Australia
Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs in Singapore, Malaysia and Australia. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle repairs with your approval and send monthly video reports. Your working day overlaps with ours, so updates and approvals usually happen the same day.
Rent from your Chennai property is generally taxable in India, and the tenant is generally required to deduct TDS. Australian residents are generally taxed on worldwide income; Singapore treats foreign income differently. India has tax treaties with Singapore, Malaysia and Australia. Your Chartered Accountant and local tax adviser should confirm what applies to you.

## Frequently asked questions
### What does Flourrish Asset Management do?
Flourrish provides end-to-end property management in Chennai. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, inspect the property, coordinate maintenance and repairs, handle authorized bill payments and send you regular reports, photos and video walkthroughs.
### Who is the service for?
Two groups mainly: NRI and overseas owners who cannot be in Chennai, and local owners who are busy, travel often or have several properties. We also support tenants who move into the properties we manage.
### How much does property management cost?
Our planned fee is 12% of the annual rental value, charged to the property owner. The service agreement explains what is included, what is excluded and any additional charges. Please confirm final pricing and tax treatment with the Flourrish team.
### How does the 12% fee work?
The fee is calculated on the property's annual rent and covers tenant coordination, rent collection, maintenance coordination, inspections, reporting and owner communication. Major repairs, renovation, government charges, CA fees, legal fees and special projects are additional and always approved by you first.
### Do you find tenants?
Yes. We market the property, handle enquiries, coordinate viewings and shortlist suitable tenants. You approve the final tenant before any agreement is signed.
### Do you verify tenants?
Yes. We carry out background checks and coordinate police verification where applicable before a tenant moves in.
### Do you collect rent?
We track rent due dates, send reminders and follow up on delayed payments, then confirm the rent status in your monthly report. Rent is paid into the account you specify in the service agreement.
### Do you manage maintenance?
Yes. When an issue is reported we send you photos or video, get an estimate from a vendor, wait for your approval, coordinate the repair and send completion photos and the invoice. Routine, low-value items can be handled within limits you set.
### Do you inspect properties?
Yes. Regular inspections are part of the service, with photos and notes documented in your report. Vacant properties are inspected on a schedule agreed with you.
### Do you provide video reports?
Yes. Periodic video walkthroughs show the condition of your property, any maintenance issues and relevant updates, so you can see it for yourself wherever you are.
### Can you manage my property if I live abroad?
Yes — NRI owners are a core focus. We communicate on WhatsApp and email at times that suit your time zone, and we can coordinate with qualified CA, legal and banking professionals for NRI-specific matters.
### Can you manage vacant properties?
Yes. Vacant property care includes periodic inspections, cleaning, pest control coordination, water and electricity checks, leakage and security checks, garden maintenance, photos, videos and emergency support. Pricing for vacant properties is quoted separately.
### Can I approve major repairs?
Always. Major repairs, large expenses, new tenants, rent changes, lease renewals and renovations all require your approval. We handle the routine work; you keep control of the decisions that matter.
### Do you help with property tax?
We can handle authorized property tax payments on your behalf and keep the receipts in your documents. Government charges are passed through at cost.
### Do you help with utility bills?
Yes. Electricity, water, gas and apartment association dues can be paid on your authorization and reported each month, so nothing lapses while you are away.
### Can you coordinate POA documentation?
We can coordinate with lawyers on Power of Attorney and other property-related documentation. Flourrish does not provide legal advice; the documentation itself is prepared and advised on by a qualified legal professional.
### Do you provide tax advice?
No. Flourrish coordinates with an empanelled Chartered Accountant for matters such as TDS on rent paid to NRIs, GST, FEMA and repatriation. Professional advice should be obtained from the appropriate licensed advisor.
### What happens during an emergency?
For issues such as leaks, electrical faults, fire, break-ins, storm damage or urgent tenant problems, our local team responds, works to secure the property, alerts you, coordinates a vendor and follows through to resolution. Emergency response procedures depend on the situation and local availability.
### Can I cancel the service?
Yes. The notice period and any handover steps are set out in your service agreement so that tenants, documents and payments are transferred back to you cleanly.
### How do I get started?
Send us a message on WhatsApp at +91 99440 70397 or use the free consultation form on this page. We will arrange a free consultation, inspect the property and share a service agreement. Regular management begins once it is signed.
### What is NRI property management?
NRI property management is a service where a local team looks after a property in India on behalf of an owner who lives abroad. In Chennai, Flourrish finds and verifies tenants, collects rent, inspects the property, arranges repairs with the owner's approval, pays property tax and bills, and sends a monthly report with photos and video.
### How do I choose a property management company in Chennai?
Look for six things: a team based in Chennai, a written service agreement, a clear tenant verification process including police verification, a rule that major repairs need your approval, regular reports with photos or video, and a fee that is stated in writing. Ask how they handle emergencies and late rent before you sign.
### Can an NRI rent out a property in India?
Yes. NRIs can rent out property they own in India. The rent is usually paid into the owner's NRO account, the tenant is generally required to deduct tax at source (TDS), and the rental income is taxable in India. A Chartered Accountant can confirm what applies to you.
### What is the difference between a property manager and a broker?
A broker usually finds a tenant or buyer for a one-time commission and steps away. A property manager looks after the property on an ongoing basis: tenant checks, rent follow-up, inspections, repairs, bills and reporting, for as long as the agreement runs.
### How often will I get updates about my property?
You get a monthly report covering rent, tenant, bills and the property's condition, with photos and video walkthroughs. Anything urgent, such as a leak or a repair that needs your approval, is sent to you on WhatsApp as it happens.
### Which areas of Chennai do you cover?
Our primary focus is OMR, ECR and South Chennai, including Sholinganallur, Perungudi, Thoraipakkam, Velachery, Adyar, Besant Nagar, Medavakkam, Tambaram, Pallavaram and Chengalpattu. If your property is elsewhere in Chennai, message us and we'll confirm.
### Is it safe to rent out my Chennai flat while I live abroad?
It can be, if the basics are done properly: a verified tenant, a written and registered rent agreement, a move-in inventory with photos, regular inspections and someone local who follows up on rent and repairs. Most problems owners face from abroad come from skipping one of these steps.

## Glossary
- Patta: A revenue record in Tamil Nadu that names the owner of a piece of land. It is issued by the revenue department and is one of the first documents checked when a property is bought, sold or inherited.
- Chitta: A Tamil Nadu land record that gives details such as the owner's name, the survey number and the size and type of the land. It is often read together with the Patta.
- Encumbrance Certificate (EC): A certificate from the sub-registrar's office that lists registered transactions on a property, such as sales and mortgages, over a chosen period. It shows whether the property carries any registered loans or claims.
- Sale deed: The registered document that transfers ownership of a property from seller to buyer. It is the main proof of ownership.
- Guideline value: The minimum value per unit area set by the Tamil Nadu government for a location. Stamp duty and registration charges are calculated on this value or the sale price, whichever is higher.
- Power of Attorney (POA): A legal document that lets someone act on your behalf. A general POA covers many actions; a specific POA covers only the tasks it names, such as registering a rent agreement. NRIs usually sign it abroad before an Indian embassy or consulate, or with notarisation and apostille, and it is then adjudicated and registered in India.
- Rent agreement: The written contract between owner and tenant setting out rent, deposit, notice period and responsibilities. In Tamil Nadu, tenancy law expects agreements to be in writing and registered with the Rent Authority.
- Rent Authority: The local authority set up under Tamil Nadu's tenancy law to register tenancy agreements and settle disputes between landlords and tenants.
- Police verification: A check of a tenant's identity and background with the local police, done before the tenant moves in.
- NRI: Non-Resident Indian: an Indian citizen who lives outside India. Residence for tax purposes is decided by the number of days spent in India, so check your status with a CA.
- NRO account: Non-Resident Ordinary account: an Indian rupee account for an NRI's income earned in India, such as rent. Money can be sent abroad from it within limits and with the required paperwork.
- NRE account: Non-Resident External account: an Indian rupee account funded from income earned abroad. It is freely repatriable. Rent from Indian property usually goes into an NRO account instead.
- TDS on rent: Tax Deducted at Source. A tenant paying rent to an NRI is generally required to deduct tax before paying and deposit it with the government. The owner can claim credit for it when filing an Indian return.
- DTAA: Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement: a tax treaty between India and another country that can stop the same income being taxed twice. India has treaties with the USA, UK, UAE, Singapore, Australia and many other countries.
- FEMA: The Foreign Exchange Management Act, the Indian law that governs how NRIs can hold, rent out and sell property and move money in and out of India.
- Security deposit: An amount the tenant pays at the start of a tenancy, returned at the end after deductions for unpaid rent or damage. The amount is agreed in the rent agreement.
- Lock-in period: A period at the start of a tenancy during which neither side can end the agreement without a penalty.
- Association maintenance charges: Monthly charges collected by an apartment owners' association for common areas, security, lifts and amenities. The rent agreement should say whether owner or tenant pays them.
- Property tax (Chennai): Tax on property within the Greater Chennai Corporation, paid in two half-yearly instalments. Properties outside the corporation pay the local body that covers them.
- Move-in inventory: A dated record, with photos, of a property's condition, fittings and meter readings when a tenant moves in. It is the basis for settling the deposit at move-out.
- OMR: Old Mahabalipuram Road, officially Rajiv Gandhi Salai: Chennai's IT corridor, running south from the city with many IT parks and gated apartment communities.
- ECR: East Coast Road: the coastal road running south from Chennai towards Mahabalipuram and Puducherry, known for villas and beach houses.
- GST Road: Grand Southern Trunk Road: the main road south-west from the city past Chennai airport, Pallavaram and Tambaram towards Chengalpattu.
- CMDA: Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority: the planning authority for the Chennai metropolitan area, which approves building plans and layouts.
- CMWSSB: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board, known as Chennai Metrowater: the body that supplies water and sewerage connections in the city.
